in_sanskrit.name: Lokita
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of the people
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lokita एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Lokita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'loka' meaning 'people'. The name signifies the goddess who protects and nurtures her people. In Hindu mythology, Lokita is a form of the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. She is believed to bring happiness and good fortune to her devotees.
